development.phase: Dylib runtime authorization, parsed App identity, runtime notices and migratable endpoints
changes: separate dylib validity from user feature entitlement
scope=2 basic, scope=3 matched-app app_plus, scope=1 global_plus
evaluate all valid cards for one UDID and choose the highest access applicable to the current App
remove dylib_app_binding from active runtime allow/block while retaining historical data and endpoints
server-side App recognition from parsed IPA identity instead of trusting client app_id or BundleID alone
Mach-O LC_UUID parsing and fa_ipa_app_identity persistence
protocol v2 additive signing fields while preserving v1 canonical order
server-controlled update text and runtime notices
multiple Bootstrap and API endpoints with signed runtime config and Last-Known-Good cache
idempotent MySQL 5.7 migration and clean-install schema

release.release_blocker: Complete BaoTa migration and real-device authorization/identity/update/notice/failover validation first

known_risks: scope=3 requires a parsed IPA identity and an active ipa_asset -> ipa_category_binding mapping; unparsed or unbound apps intentionally cannot receive app_plus
BundleID is not a sufficient App identity; runtime matching also uses executable and Mach-O UUID resolved against server-side parsed data
changing the server/domain is resilient only while at least one Bootstrap, legacy endpoint, or valid Last-Known-Good configuration remains reachable/usable
separately purchased entitlements such as cloud save must not be inferred from basic/app_plus/global_plus
real BaoTa and real-device behavior remains unverified despite full CI success
next_task: Deploy 2406 in a test/BaoTa environment, re-parse an actively bound App, then execute the real-device matrix for scope=2/scope=3/scope=1, BundleID-spoof negative testing, updates/notices, API-domain migration, Bootstrap failover, Last-Known-Good and offline grace before preparing source-v2026092406.
